get.summary: Liveness probe

post.summary: Apply every due scheduled change (external cron / scheduler)

affectedTables.description: what the batch touches (keyword-anchored, best effort)

driver.description: Driver is derived at read time from the connection that serves the change; it is never stored.

estDurationMs.description: measured on the dry run (estimates) and on apply (actuals)

scheduledAt.description: ScheduledAt is the unix time the change should run; 0 means execute immediately (on manual apply, as before).

status.description: validated | unverified | failed | approved | applying | applied | rejected

id.description: ID identifies an instance across drivers; permissions and changes still link by Name.

documents.description: Documents carries raw engine output as Extended JSON (MongoDB reads).

scratchSchema.description: ScratchSchema is set by change validation: the throwaway schema the change was verified against, if any.

capabilities.description: Capabilities names what this profile lets the console prove, in the operator's words.

engine.description: Engine is the driver the connection speaks (postgres, mysql, sqlite).

version.description: Version is the version string the server reported.
